title: tephrosia pumila
intro: Tephrosia pumila, commonly known as the dwarf hoary pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia pumila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia pumila, including flavonoids and alkaloids, are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
